description: Elections Commission - Declare that Mohammadu Musthafa Jezeema was selected as the member of the Kattankudy Urban Council
categorisation: This gazette concerns the filling of a vacancy for a member of the Kattankudy Urban Council, a process governed by the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. The content specifically details the electoral procedure for declaring a new council member, which falls under the category of electoral processes and related matters.
